release_notes: LeadForge 2.0 Reference Synchronization & 150-GEO Validation Engine. Integrates the complete 150-country GEO validation dataset with exact national and international regex patterns, mobile operator prefixes, min/max length rules, and 33-language localized messages. The JavaScript adapter (orbitra_adapter.js) now features dynamic country switching on <select name="country">, live visual input badge counters, strict Unicode name validation, haptic vibration feedback, and cross-page ClickID/SubID parameter hydration. The universal order.php handler adds native support for 10 CPA networks (Dr.Cash, Webvork, Lucky.online, KMA.biz, TerraLeads, Leadbit, LemonAD, Everad, Ezaff, Custom Webhooks), automated E.164 phone normalization, in-process and remote CRM vault dual logging, and local failsafe lead logging.
